singular VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: singular wallet COMMAND

Keep a signing key in an encrypted vault

The wallet commands are local: they take no provider, blueprint or registry
setting, and refuse each by name. The passphrase is read from the terminal
with the echo off, or as one line from --passphrase-fd; it is never an
argument, and no output, refusal or trace names it.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

Available commands:
  create    Create a vault with a fresh key      
  address   Print the address of a vault's key   
  sign      Sign a bundle of transactions offline
